findings.evidence: Planner marks `ON UPDATE` columns as “in on-duplicate list” unconditionally in `pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go:3955-3959` (writes `onDups[column.Name.L] = struct{}{}`) even when the SQL has no `ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE` (because `resolveOnDuplicate` always returns a non-nil map: `pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go:4139-4141`). Generated columns depending on those `ON UPDATE` columns then get appended to `igc.OnDuplicates` (`pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go:3983-3991`). Executor builder always appends generated-column OnDuplicates into executor OnDuplicate: `pkg/executor/builder.go:1045-1048`. Insert executor switches behavior purely on `len(e.OnDuplicate)>0`: `pkg/executor/insert.go:90-100`, so a normal INSERT can be routed into `batchUpdateDupRows`. On duplicates, if OnDuplicate contains only generated-column assignments, `doDupRowUpdate` evaluates no non-generated assignments (`pkg/executor/insert.go:465-475`), then `updateRecord` can early-return “no changes” without applying generated assignments (`pkg/executor/write.go:165-185`), meaning duplicate-key conflicts become silent no-op updates instead of errors/ignore.
findings.fix: Ensure generated-column `OnDuplicates` are only produced/propagated when the statement actually has `ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE`. Minimal options: (1) in `resolveGeneratedColumns`, only add `ON UPDATE` columns into `onDups` if `onDups != nil && len(onDups) > 0`; (2) pass `nil` for `onDups` when `len(insert.OnDuplicate)==0`; or (3) in `pkg/executor/builder.go`, append `v.GenCols.OnDuplicates` only when `len(v.OnDuplicate)>0`.
findings.impact: MySQL-compatibility and correctness: a plain `INSERT` / `INSERT IGNORE` into a table that has an `ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP` column and generated columns depending on it can incorrectly behave like `INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE` (duplicate-key errors suppressed; `INSERT IGNORE` may update instead of ignore). This can silently change application behavior and data consistency expectations.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked `upstream/master` for this pattern; `ResolveOnDuplicate` still returns a non-nil empty map for empty `onDup`, executor still gates ON DUP behavior on `len(OnDuplicate)`, so this semantic issue does not appear to be fixed up to `upstream/master`.
findings.verify: Repro idea: create table with `t1 datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP` and `t2 ... GENERATED ALWAYS AS (date_add(t1, interval 1 day)) VIRTUAL` plus a UNIQUE/PK; insert one row; then run a plain duplicate insert without `ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE` and assert it errors with duplicate key. Also check `INSERT IGNORE` duplicate remains ignored (no update).
findings.what: Blocker: `resolveGeneratedColumns` can make `InsertExec.OnDuplicate` non-empty even when the SQL has no `ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE` (via `ON UPDATE` columns), causing normal INSERT/INSERT IGNORE to take the ON DUPLICATE execution path and potentially suppress duplicate-key errors (no-op update).

subject: planner/core: update missing virtual columns in `update` and `insert` (#58401)
summary: Fix intent is clear (propagate on-update-now + transitive deps for virtual/generated columns in UPDATE and INSERT ON DUPLICATE), but `resolveGeneratedColumns` introduces a Blocker by populating `OnDuplicate` machinery even when the SQL has no `ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE`, potentially changing duplicate-key semantics for certain schemas.
